anchor: Which forest hunter gets a bonus to attacks when a buddy stands within five feet of its target, and bites knocking victims flat?
Which woodland beast can see in the dark out to 60 feet, moves 40 feet per turn, and cannot speak any language?
Which large sea creature can breathe both air and water, bites to poison, and grabs with a hook that can yank victims closer?
My party is facing a brute that gets two attacks per turn from swipes, bites and hooks, and it can reel a victim in. What is it?
At level two, which ability lets me use a quick extra move each turn to sprint, back off from foes, or slip out of sight?
I want to get away from a fight and vanish from view in one turn while still keeping my main attack available. What can I do?
Which magic drink gives an extra buffer of 10 health lasting an hour, plus a divine favor effect that needs no sustained focus?
Before a brutal battle, I want a steaming, bubbling vial that gives me a health buffer and makes my strikes and saves luckier for an hour. What is it?
Which third-level magic lets me touch a willing friend so they shrug off half of one elemental harm type, chosen from fire, cold, acid, lightning, or thunder?
My teammate is walking into a fiery or icy blast zone. Can I touch them so they take less harm from it for up to an hour?
Which deep-sea giant can spray a 15-foot cloud of ink underwater that blinds and poisons anything inside, with a save DC of 23?
Which monster gets three or four extra moves it can squeeze in right after a rival's turn, refreshed at the start of its own turn?
Which large sky spirit reappears after being slain away from its home plane, and rolls with advantage against spells and magical effects?
Which foe shrugs off lightning and thunder damage, has 218 hit points, and gets three attacks per turn mixing slashes and blasts?
Which hulking brute has 68 hit points, a 40-foot pace, and throws spears up to 120 feet while swinging a huge cudgel?
Which large creature with an Intelligence of 5 and Charisma of 7 smashes with a heavy club for 2d8 plus 4?
Which hour-long magic lets me appear a foot taller or shorter and heavier or lighter, but a hand on my added accessory finds nothing solid?
If I alter my look to pass as a stranger, what must a watcher do to see through the ruse, and what number must their check beat?
Which young metallic drake is immune to corrosion, breathes a corrosive line, and has a cone that halves speed?
Which medium chaotic good creature flies 60 feet, has 10 feet of sight-free sensing, and uses DC 11 rolls to resist its breath?
Which second-level magic links me to a willing ally through matching precious bands, giving them +1 to armor class and saves, while sharing damage taken?
When my linked ally gets hit, does the damage come to me too, and does the link break if we're more than 60 feet apart?
Which airborne foe conjures a spinning column within 120 feet that traps victims, with a DC 17 Strength save to resist each turn?
What creature fires a 120-foot ranged blast that can knock a victim flat, and casts spells using charisma with DC 17?
At level five, which wizard feature lets me swap one prepared magic for another from my tome after a brief rest?
Which seventh-level healing magic restores 4d8 plus 15 hit points immediately and regrows lost limbs after two minutes for an hour?
My ally lost a hand in battle and I have a minute and a devotional trinket. What magic could restore their vitality and regrow the hand?
Which large rock-and-soil monster burrows through unworked rock without disturbing it, takes extra harm from booming sound, and deals double damage to buildings?
Which large stone-bodied brute can't be frozen in place, turned to stone, poisoned, knocked out, or worn down by fatigue?
Which ninth-level magic lets a wizard or druid transform into a creature of challenge rating no higher than their level, but not a construct or undead?
I want to become a creature I've seen before, keeping my mind, speech, and hit points while gaining its body and attacks. What magic does this?
Which spellcasting origin comes from a bequest of an ancient scaled ancestor or from magic soaked into a treasure pile?
Which attuned weapon pushes my Strength up to 20, adds 1d8 booming harm per hit, and can knock foes in a 30-foot cone flat with a clap?
Is there a magic bludgeon that lets me strike a hard surface to make a bang audible about 300 feet away, with DC 15 saves to avoid falling?
Which footwear needing attunement lets me spend a charge to soar at 30 feet of air speed for an hour, with charges refilling at dawn?
If my enchanted shoes' flight wears off while I'm airborne, how fast do I sink until my feet touch ground?
If instant travel magic backfires, what harm do travelers suffer, and do they land somewhere that merely resembles their goal?
I have a keepsake from a scholar's library taken within six months. Does that help me jump there with instant travel magic?
Which second-level ranger perk lets me pick a skill I'm already good at and get the top-tier version of it?
My wilderness scout reached second level and wants to learn two new spoken tongues from the character creation tables. Which feature grants that?
Which level-one rogue feature gives me a secret street slang plus one more language of my choice from the character creation tables?
Which uncommon magic drink shields me from one of ten harm types for an hour, such as acid, life-draining, or radiant, picked by a random d10 roll?
Could a Game Master randomly assign a one-hour shield against cold, fire, or thunder when I drink a magic liquid, or must I pick it myself?
Which feathered celestial serpent can twice a day cast a divine favor boost or a lesser cure as a quick extra action?
Which celestial creature can read thoughts at will and once a day either put people to sleep or lift a curse?
Which feat adds my ability modifier to damage on an extra off-hand swing with a light blade, if I'm not already adding it?
Which feat is open only to a character with a combat-style class trait, and boosts damage on a second light-weapon strike?
Which first-level cleric magic lets me hurl a shaft of light 120 feet away, dealing 4d6 holy harm, and makes the next strike on it easier?
Which cleric's light attack gains one more d6 for every slot level above the first, starting at 4d6 damage?
Which third-level blast of flame lets me pick a point 150 feet away, then deals 8d6 searing harm in a 20-foot radius, with half on a successful agility roll?
Which magic needs cave-dweller droppings mixed with brimstone as its focus, and makes a blast that ignites flammable loose items nearby?
Which huge lawful good wyrm breathes a 60-foot cone of flame for 12d10 damage with a DC 21 agility save, and flies 80 feet?
What flame-proof wyrm gets three chances a day to turn a failed save into a success and can swim through water?
Which sixth-level magic lets me pre-set a single self-targeted action-based effect that fires automatically when a chosen trigger happens, lasting 10 days?
If I'm plunged under a lake, can a backup spell I prepared earlier kick in on its own, and does it end if I lose the figurine I carry?
At the very top of the monk's path, which capstone raises my agility and wisdom by four each, to a ceiling of 25?
Which high-level magic turns a nonliving thing into a monster of challenge rating 9 or lower that acts right after me and obeys my commands?
If I transform a foe into a rock or chair, does it keep its memories when it reverts, and does its gear come along?
Which sixth-level banquet conjured in a 10-foot cube can serve twelve people, granting poison resistance plus immunity to fear and toxic sickness for a day?
Our party needs a long-lasting boost before a dungeon crawl. Is there a meal-conjuring rite that adds 2d10 maximum health to up to twelve people?
Which third-level magic lets up to ten willing friends within 30 feet take in air while under the surface for a full day, keeping their usual lung function?
We need to explore a sunken vault for a full day. Is there a rite that lets up to ten allies stay submerged without surfacing?
Which rare rod-like item with seven charges points toward the nearest foe within 60 feet for a minute, even if they're hidden or invisible?
After my rod's final charge is spent, what's the chance it crumbles to dust, and how many charges come back each dawn?
Which tiny chaotic evil demon can turn invisible at will, frighten a foe once a day, and poison a victim with its claws?
Which little demon shrugs off cold, flame, and lightning damage and is immune to poison, yet can shift into a bat, centipede, or toad?
When I wear no protective gear, how do I figure my armor rating at first level from agility and toughness modifiers?
If I strap a shield on while wearing no armor, does the bare-body armor math still count, or does the shield cancel it?
Which ancient frost wyrm can, right after another creature's turn, cast a paralysis-like hold or breathe a 60-foot icy line that shoves victims 30 feet away?
I want a wyrm that hurls magical ice shards and casts a truth-binding field once a day; which one has a spell DC of 19?
Which small bird-like beast flies 60 feet, sees keenly, and slashes with claws for 1d4 plus 2?
What small flying hunter has 4 hit points, challenge rating zero, and a perception bonus of +6?
Which single-use trinket shaped like a plume can halt a ship for a day, summon a giant flying bird, or speed a vessel's sails?
Which uncommon one-shot charm, tossed from a boat, makes a giant fan billow that adds 5 miles per hour for eight hours?
At fifth level, which rogue perk lets me sacrifice one die of my bonus damage to knock a mid-sized-or-smaller foe flat unless it passes an agility roll?
I want to coat my blade in a toxin that keeps a victim sickened for a minute, repeating a toughness roll each turn. What kit do I need?
